completed_targets.target: Benchmark-driven fix: exact token accounting in the history trimmer
completed_targets.metric_delta: Benchmarked trimMessagesToBudget on a synthetic 5003-message / 5.4M-token history: the benchmark exposed that tool outputs dropped via the pairing flag never had their tokens subtracted from the internal estimate, and the arbitrary +4-per-message fudge made bookkeeping drift from the real estimate — the trimmer over-dropped history and could exit over budget. Fixed: paired tool outputs now decrement the estimate, and the fudge is removed so bookkeeping is exact (verified: internal estimate == estimateMessagesTokens after trim within the budget). Regression test added (30 tool pairs, budget fits exactly 3 pairs — asserts kept >= 2 pairs, last-2 preserved, real estimate <= budget); 59/59 green. completed_targets.target: Handle unclosed think tags from truncated reasoning models
completed_targets.metric_delta: Before: a truncated reasoning generation (e.g. deepseek-r1 on Ollama cut mid-thought) emitted an unclosed think-open tag; extractThinkingAndContent fell through to the no-tag path and the raw reasoning leaked into cleanContent — polluting the chat UI and potentially corrupting tool-call JSON parsing. After: when an open tag exists and no close tag does, everything after the open tag is treated as thinking and stripped from content. Closed-tag behavior unchanged (pinned by a new test). 2 new tests; 68/68 green. Note: the think-tag literal is built via String.fromCharCode in tests and kept literal in source — an earlier edit actually lost the tag bytes (searched for 'region'); the new tests would have caught that.
completed_targets.commit: fix(ai): treat unclosed think tags as reasoning, not content

backlog: Consider honoring upstream community 3D PRs (#8343-#8349) via cherry-pick if upstream stalls (roadmap B)
heuristics: Never modify upstream GDCore bindings unless exposing new scriptable AI APIs
Prefer pure JS/TS mocks for local AI endpoint testing to avoid external network calls during CI

The Edit tool collapsed leading whitespace across 2360 lines of CustomAIClient.js — for this codebase prefer python-based exact-text replacement for surgical edits in large Flow files; verify with `git diff --stat` that the footprint matches the intended change
LSP diagnostics on Flow files are TS-parser noise (8006/8008/8010) — use eslint as the source of truth there
Client is non-streaming (axios POST); SSE-recovery hardening does not apply to current architecture
customSuspendAiRequest is synchronous and lock-free by design (cache-copy swap); abort controllers live outside the cache so suspension works even for requests not yet persisted
GitHub Actions versions audited cycle 5 — all current; re-check after upstream syncs
parseAssistantMessage fixtures must use schema-valid arguments (GDEVELOP_OPENAI_TOOLS is the validation source of truth since cycle 11)
getCustomEndpointConfig treats localStorage as untrusted input — field-level coercion on load; keep that property when adding new CustomAIConfig fields
KeyboardShortcuts supports onDelete (Backspace+Delete) and excludes text editors — reuse it for list panels instead of ad-hoc keydown handlers

Resource-from-local-file pattern: copyAllToProjectFolder + relative setFile + resourcesManager.addResource + newResource.delete() — same as LocalResourceSources file picker; Electron File.path is the only local-path source
scaleMode (nearest) and pixelsRounding already exist as project properties — upstream #7495's core ask is satisfied; do not re-implement

Local-server failure payloads vary by server (Ollama: 'requires more system memory'; llama.cpp: 'failed to allocate'); error hints must match broadly but never alter the original message for unmatched errors
normalizeBaseUrl coerces all inputs to http(s) — non-HTTP schemes (file:, data:) cannot reach sendChatCompletion; do not add raw fetch paths that bypass it
Flow error lines are formatted 'Error --- src/...'; anchoring greps at ^src/ silently returns 0. Baseline: 48 src errors in CustomAIClient.js/spec on clean HEAD — compare counts, not grep positions
Benchmark loops with synthetic worst-case data before accepting trimmer/compaction changes — the 5003-message benchmark caught a bookkeeping bug the unit tests missed
eslint --fix resolves import/first ordering automatically — prefer it over manual import relocation when inserting components mid-file
